preliminary_ci.superseded_reason: Final tests inspect child.returncode before waitpid, rather than letting assertion-side poll reap a child; timeout and overflow also require recorded SIGKILL. No diagnostic implementation changed.

coverage: Source address, role receipt, network-namespace match/mismatch, unavailable route, stop and identity rejection use synthetic node/command fixtures.
ICMP error categories and no-echo versus execution-timeout classification are checked against synthetic stdout/stderr, including real Linux pipe delivery.
nft chains, catch-all drops/jumps, receipt-address membership, rule changes, counter resets/unknowns and strict export filtering use synthetic rulesets; no real nft command is executed.
Real Linux children verify merged stdout/stderr, normal and nonzero exit, deadline kill, output overflow kill, EOF before process exit, closed pipes and already-reaped PIDs.
Real Linux procfs checks cover network-namespace links and zero-size ICMP counter files without sending ICMP packets.
Real nonroot filesystem permission denial refuses the new collector before command execution and exercises existing staging/journal/driver safeguards.

A mocked node bridge with four real child timeouts preserves unknown counts, persists the fixed-schema diagnostic before original cleanup, and confirms all children already reaped before that cleanup runs once.
The complete existing offline regression suite also checks frozen tool pins, scope restrictions, failed writes, foreign receipts, stopped/deleted/closed contexts and no diagnostic replay.
limitations: The core implementation is the exact base version; the temporary CI commit adds Linux regressions, a sandbox harness and branch-specific workflow/filter only.
Synthetic ICMP streams and nft rulesets are not actual public-network errors, actual node firewall behavior or effective filtering proof.
The real namespace checks use the CI process, not a deployed kelinode daemon. Capabilities, routes and source bindings on a new cloud node still require separately approved live verification.
Source context and counter evidence cannot reconstruct R10's deleted VM or establish its historical drop point or censorship.
The four Windows-native tests are deliberately excluded from Linux, not silently counted as passed.
This does not authorize or complete a new VM installation, HY2 forwarding, controlled fault, DNS cutover or full failover run.
The temporary workflow, push filter and CI-only harness must not be merged into the production branch without a separately scoped integration.
